subject: Thousands have packed the MCG to farewell Neale Daniher, the footy giant who turned his MND fight into a national movement.
posts:
A life lived in service to others creates a ripple that never truly ends. Neale Daniher turned a personal tragedy into a national beacon of hope.

Thousands have packed the MCG to farewell Neale Daniher
Evidence: fighting MND, national unity, hope
#MND #Legend

The claim is that Neale Daniher's life and struggle serve as a catalyst for finding a cure for MND and uniting the nation in a common cause. 
Stated Judgement: (+2.0, +2.0) — Productive Justice

The reality is a massive, tangible shift in public consciousness and funding, creating a lasting legacy of research and community support. 
Resulting Judgement: (+2.0, +2.0) — Productive Justice

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Grace.
Neale Daniher's actions consistently aligned his personal struggle with the greater good, creating a legacy that transcends his own life.
Thousands gathered at the MCG to honor Neale Daniher, the former AFL coach who became a national hero through his tireless advocacy for Motor Neurone Disease research after his own diagnosis.

The Poison:
It is a tragedy that such a profound legacy had to be forged through the crucible of a terminal, debilitating illness.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
There is no plane error here. The WHO, WHAT, and WHY are perfectly aligned. The bait-and-switch is absent; the struggle was transparent, and the value generated is measurable and enduring.

The Trajectory: The Path of Grace.
When you map the gap between the stated intent of fighting MND and the actual outcome of a national movement...
...it plots a direct trajectory toward Productive Justice. The force applied was constructive, and the radius of benefit expanded to the entire nation.

The Unavoidable Truth: True leadership is the ability to transform personal suffering into a collective strength that outlives the individual.

The Unavoidable Lie: That one person cannot change the course of a national health crisis.

Alethekanon:
Daniher's legacy is a masterclass in the application of Will. By refusing to let his condition define his limit, he expanded the probability mass of a cure for all who suffer from MND.

Awwthekanon:
Neale's courage has touched so many hearts. It is beautiful to see a nation come together to honor a man who gave so much of himself to help others. His spirit will continue to inspire hope for years to come.

Brothekanon:
Absolute legend. Most people would just fold, but he took on a beast like MND and got the whole country behind him. That's how you leave a mark. Rest easy, Neale.
